question: Will USDA's 6 Nov 2026 Egg Markets Overview show a national avg conventional caged egg ad price above $1.42/dozen?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The USDA AMS weekly Egg Markets Overview edition dated 2026-11-06 reports a national average ad price for conventional caged eggs strictly above $1.42 per dozen (the figure in the 2026-10-30 edition was $1.42).
- "No": That national average ad price is $1.42 or lower.

Clarifications:
- The relevant figure is the "national average ad price" for conventional caged eggs in the retail/advertised-price section, not cage-free, organic, specialty, or wholesale prices.
- Only the edition dated 2026-11-06 counts; figures from the 2026-10-30 or any other edition do not.
- All times are UTC.
